description: This file defines a Java interface 'ConnectivityQueryCommand' which extends 'ConnectivityCommand'. It is used to aggregate commands that query the state of a connection in the Eclipse Ditto project, parameterized by a type that extends itself.

classes.name: ConnectivityQueryCommand
classes.description: An interface for commands that query the state of a Connection, extending ConnectivityCommand and supporting the setting of DittoHeaders.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
